commands.command: set -e; EXPECTED=e5ab31039f6f956362b9bc77de4cde3a1a6c0b32; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/work/phase1-live-call-probes | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d 'market://details?id=moe.shizuku.privileged.api' -p com.android.vending >/dev/null; sleep 5; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/window.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; XML=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/window.xml 2>/dev/null || true); printf '%s' "$XML" | grep -q 'text="Shizuku"'; printf '%s' "$XML" | grep -q 'content-desc="Install"'; echo install_button_verified=true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap 541 1188; INSTALLED=0; for i in $(seq 1 30); do if adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path --user 0 moe.shizuku.privileged.api 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^package:'; then INSTALLED=1; break; fi; sleep 2; done; echo installed=$INSTALLED; if [ "$INSTALLED" != 1 ]; then adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/window.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/window.xml 2>/dev/null | tr '<' '
<' | grep -Ei 'Shizuku|Install|Open|Pending|Cancel|Verify|authentication|password' | head -n 100 || true; exit 12; fi; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path --user 0 moe.shizuku.privileged.api; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell monkey -p moe.shizuku.privileged.api 1 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 3; SCRIPT=''; for p in /sdcard/Android/data/moe.shizuku.privileged.api/start.sh /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/moe.shizuku.privileged.api/start.sh; do if adb -s "$SERIAL" shell test -f "$p"; then SCRIPT=$p; break; fi; done; echo start_script=$SCRIPT; if [ -n "$SCRIPT" ]; then adb -s "$SERIAL" shell sh "$SCRIPT" 2>&1 || true; sleep 3; fi; echo '=== shizuku processes ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A | grep -Ei 'shizuku|rikka' || true; echo phase2c_install_start_shizuku_complete=true
